hypotheses.justification: Implied by the other hypotheses: hb gives 0 ≤ 2b and hsmall gives 2b < d, so 0 < d by linarith. Replace the binder by `have hd : 0 < d := by linarith` and keep the rest of the proof.

If 2b < d, the existing proof applies. Otherwise d ≤ 2b, so d^2 - 4b^2 ≤ 0 (since 0 < d ≤ 2b) and Real.sqrt (d^2 - 4b^2) = 0 by Real.sqrt_eq_zero'. The right-hand side is then 2b/d, which is ≥ 1 because 2b ≥ d > 0 (le_div_iff₀). Since ht1 gives t < 1, we get t ≤ RHS. So the statement holds without hsmall (with hb, hd, ht1, hquad kept).

If b ≥ 0, the existing proof applies. If b < 0, write c = -b > 0; hsmall holds automatically. hquad says c t^2 + d t + c ≤ 0. Multiplying by 4c gives (2ct + d)^2 ≤ d^2 - 4c^2, so d^2 - 4b^2 ≥ 0, s := sqrt(d^2 - 4b^2) satisfies s^2 = d^2 - 4b^2, and 2ct + d ≤ s, i.e. t ≤ (s - d)/(2c). Since (s - d)(s + d) = -4c^2 and d + s > 0, (s - d)/(2c) = -2c/(d + s) = 2b/(d + s), which is the right-hand side. So the conclusion holds for b < 0 as well (using hd, not ht1). Each of hb, hsmall, hd can be removed on its own; removing both hb and hd together is not claimed.
